## Dead Exports
- None found. This repo is script-first; the Node/Python files are executed directly and their internal functions are used within-file rather than exported as library APIs.

## Wrapper Functions
- `scripts/edc:70` — `find_cursor_build_skill()` is a pure wrapper around `find_skill()`.
- `scripts/edc:77` — `find_codex_build_skill()` is a pure wrapper around `find_skill()`.
- `scripts/edc-review.sh:362` — `find_cursor_skill()` is a pure wrapper around `find_installed_skill()`.

## Over-Abstracted Modules
- `agent-wrappers` — many small wrapper commands/skills exist only to point back at canonical files (`agents/cursor/.cursor/commands/*.md`, `agents/codex/.codex/skills/*.md`). Suggested simplification: keep the thin wrappers, but treat them strictly as generated/manifested surfaces or reduce doc duplication where possible.

## Duplication
- Exact duplicate: `scripts/edc-review.sh:1` and `plugins/edc/scripts/edc-review.sh:1` are byte-identical 940-line orchestrator copies. Suggested simplification: generate one from the other or centralize the source-of-truth copy.
- Near-duplicate legacy copy: `.edc/scripts/edc-review.sh:1` preserves an older orchestrator variant with overlapping logic. Suggested simplification: remove or mechanically sync the legacy copy.
- Manifest duplication: `install.sh:27`, `agents/cursor/install.sh:39`, and `agents/codex/install.sh:43` repeat canonical skill file lists. Suggested simplification: generate the lists or assert them from one shared manifest.
- Test-flow duplication: `tests/hardening/t6-auto-mode.sh:30` and `tests/hardening/t7-codex-auto-mode.sh:23` are structurally similar mocked auto-mode flows. Suggested simplification: share fixture helpers if the shell-only style remains maintainable.

## Oversized Files
- `scripts/edc-review.sh:1` — 940 LOC, >500 LOC and >3x repo median (37.5). Suggested simplification: split stream handling, prompt resolution, and build-mode generation into sourced helpers or generated script fragments.
- `plugins/edc/scripts/edc-review.sh:1` — 940 LOC duplicate of the same oversized orchestrator. Suggested simplification: eliminate duplicate source copies.
- `.edc/scripts/edc-review.sh:1` — 674 LOC stale near-duplicate. Suggested simplification: stop versioning the legacy copy or sync it mechanically.
- `benchmark/autoresearch.sh:1` — 791 LOC monolith that owns repo discovery, caching, prompting, git mutation, and benchmarking. Suggested simplification: split cache/benchmark/mutation phases into helpers.

## Deep Call Chains
- Build flow: `scripts/edc` -> `resolve_build_prompt()` -> agent CLI wrapper -> `edc-build-impl` -> `edc-context`/`edc-split-impl`/`edc-audit-impl`. Depth is effectively 5-6 hops for a user-visible "build context" operation. Suggested simplification: keep the layering, but document the source-of-truth chain clearly and avoid extra duplicate wrappers.
- Review flow: `scripts/edc review` -> `review_cmd()` -> `scripts/edc-review.sh` -> `resolve_prompt()` -> agent CLI subprocess -> review command/skill wrapper -> `edc-review-impl`. Suggested simplification: preserve the orchestrator boundary, but collapse duplicate wrapper surfaces where they add no user value.

## Test Mirroring
- `tests/hardening/t7-cli-entrypoint.sh:30` recreates fake agent binaries and inspects prompt text/flags directly rather than going through a reusable test helper. Suggested simplification: extract shared fake-agent helpers for shell tests.
- `tests/hardening/t6-auto-mode.sh:30` and `tests/hardening/t7-codex-auto-mode.sh:23` partially reimplement runtime prompt parsing assumptions inside mocks. Suggested simplification: share a mock harness or centralize prompt-shape fixtures.

# Complexity Audit

## Summary
- Bloat score: 7/10 (behavior is understandable, but a lot of packaging and orchestration complexity is concentrated in a few places)
- Dead exports: 0
- Wrapper functions: 4
- Over-abstracted modules: 2
- Duplicated code blocks: 4
- Oversized files: 8

## LOC Estimates vs Reality
| Module | Estimated LOC | Actual LOC | Ratio | Verdict |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `cli-wrapper` | 250 | 479 | 1.92x | High but still explainable by multi-runtime packaging |
| `plugin-interface` | 140 | 231 | 1.65x | Reasonable for wrapper/docs layer |
| `hook-runtime` | 220 | 385 | 1.75x | Moderate overhead from cross-runtime parsing + dedup |
| `review-orchestrator` | 350 | 940 | 2.69x | **Flagged:** too much control flow in one file |
| `build-review-skills` | 1200 | 2451 | 2.04x | **Flagged:** methodology surface is larger than the runtime it drives |
| `agent-installers` | 300 | 538 | 1.79x | Duplication-heavy but not extreme |
| `hardening-tests` | 650 | 1095 | 1.68x | Large but justified by multi-runtime contract coverage |

## Dead Exports
- No dead JS/TS exports found in the checked-in runtime code. The Node hook files are script entrypoints rather than export-oriented modules, and the shell scripts keep helper functions internal.

## Wrapper Functions
- `scripts/edc:70` `find_cursor_build_skill()` is a one-line specialization of `find_skill()` with fixed search roots. Suggested simplification: inline the search roots at call sites or collapse to a single helper with a runtime parameter.
- `scripts/edc:77` `find_codex_build_skill()` is the Codex twin of the same pattern. Suggested simplification: share one runtime-parameterized helper.
- `plugins/edc/scripts/edc-review.sh:362` `find_cursor_skill()` is a thin wrapper over `find_installed_skill()`. Suggested simplification: resolve via one helper that accepts the runtime search roots.
- `plugins/edc/scripts/edc-review.sh:367` `find_codex_skill()` repeats the same pass-through shape. Suggested simplification: collapse it with the Cursor variant.

## Over-Abstracted Modules
- `plugin-interface` has many tiny command wrappers (`plugins/edc/commands/*.md`) for very small behavioral differences. Suggested simplification: keep the wrappers, but generate or template them from a shared source to reduce drift.
- `agent-installers` exposes similar build/update/split/audit wrappers in both Cursor command files and Codex skill files. Suggested simplification: derive these from one shared template or generator.

## Duplication
- The canonical skill manifest is repeated across `install.sh:27`, `agents/cursor/install.sh:39`, and `agents/codex/install.sh:43`. Suggested simplification: generate local installers from the canonical list or keep a machine-readable manifest.
- Review launcher wrapper content is duplicated across `plugins/edc/commands/edc-run-review.md:17`, `agents/cursor/.cursor/commands/edc-run-review.md:18`, and `agents/codex/.codex/skills/edc-run-review/SKILL.md:24`. Suggested simplification: template these wrappers from a single source.
- Build/update/split/audit wrapper files are near-identical in `plugins/edc/commands/*`, `agents/cursor/.cursor/commands/*`, and `agents/codex/.codex/skills/*`. Suggested simplification: generate the runtime-specific wrappers from shared metadata.
- Orchestrator code exists in multiple repo paths: `plugins/edc/scripts/edc-review.sh:1`, `scripts/edc-review.sh:1`, and `.edc/scripts/edc-review.sh:1`, with the checked-in `.edc` copy currently diverged. Suggested simplification: keep only one checked-in source file and generate/copy the rest.

## Oversized Files
- Median tracked source file size across the analyzed modules is about 64 LOC.
- `plugins/edc/scripts/edc-review.sh:1` at 940 LOC is >14x median and exceeds the 500 LOC threshold. Suggested simplification: split prompt resolution, task generation, and consolidation helpers into separate sourced files or generated fragments.
- `plugins/edc/skills/edc-review-impl/reporting.md:1` at 365 LOC is >5x median. Suggested simplification: split format requirements from examples/pattern catalog.
- `plugins/edc/skills/edc-context/SKILL.md:1` at 334 LOC is >5x median. Suggested simplification: keep the core skill short and move detailed examples/checklists into companion docs.
- `plugins/edc/skills/edc-review-impl/methodology.md:1` at 299 LOC is >4x median. Suggested simplification: break phases into smaller reference docs.
- `plugins/edc/skills/edc-review-impl/patterns.md:1` at 293 LOC is >4x median. Suggested simplification: split pattern families into separate files.
- `scripts/edc:1` at 269 LOC is >4x median. Suggested simplification: keep only CLI parsing here and move prompt-resolution helpers into shared shell fragments.
- `tests/hardening/t7-cli-entrypoint.sh:1` at 266 LOC is >4x median. Suggested simplification: extract repeated fake-agent setup into a shared test helper script.
- `plugins/edc/hooks/pretooluse-context-inject.mjs:1` at 213 LOC is >3x median. Suggested simplification: separate path extraction, module resolution, and dedup into smaller helpers/modules.

## Deep Call Chains
- Build flow depth is roughly 5 hops: `scripts/edc build` -> `resolve_build_prompt()` -> runtime wrapper/skill -> `edc-build-impl` -> `edc-context`/split/audit. Suggested simplification: keep the stages but document the hop chain in generated metadata or centralize prompt routing.
- Review flow depth is roughly 6 hops: runtime wrapper -> `.edc/scripts/edc-review.sh` -> `resolve_prompt()` -> build/update/review subprocess -> task file -> review skill/reporting. Suggested simplification: collapse thin wrapper layers where runtime UX does not require them.

## Test Mirroring
- `tests/hardening/t1-tool-lockdown.sh:7`, `t2-stream-filter.sh:66`, `t5-portability-install.sh:33`, and `t7-cli-entrypoint.sh:103` assert exact flags and prompt strings. This is valuable contract coverage, but it mirrors implementation closely. Suggested simplification: move repeated expected strings into shared shell test helpers/constants.
- `tests/hardening/t6-auto-mode.sh:44` and `t7-codex-auto-mode.sh:55` emulate build/update/review phase recognition by looking for prompt substrings. Suggested simplification: pin on a smaller explicit phase token instead of broader prompt text.
